description: Source code for handling HTTP requests related to button and dialog interactions within a Mattermost plugin flow, including request decoding, flow control, and post-processing.

classes.name: Flow
classes.description: Represents a flow instance managing steps, state, and interactions within the plugin.

methods.name: handleButtonHTTP
methods.description: HTTP handler for processing button click requests, decodes request, validates user, and triggers flow handling.

methods.name: handleDialogHTTP
methods.description: HTTP handler for processing dialog submission requests, decodes request, validates user, and triggers flow handling.

methods.name: handleButton
methods.description: Handles button interactions within the flow, returns the post and error.

methods.name: handleDialog
methods.description: Handles dialog submissions within the flow, returns the post, field errors, and error.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Core method to process button or dialog actions, update state, and determine next step.

methods.name: processButtonPostActions
methods.description: Processes post actions related to button interactions, updating attachment URLs.
